generate_modular_addition_dataset: generate a modular addition dataset given group order M and number of operations
generate_perm_dataset: generate a permutation dataset from the symmetric group of size M
load_non_abelian_collection: load a non-abelian group collection from a JSONL file by index and max irrep degree
ModularAdditionNN: build a neural network model for modular addition with configurable activation and batch norm
main: run the modular addition training loop with configurable group type, optimizer, and loss function
